rebaselined_note: v2.0.0 rebaseline (2026-10-01): TRUE-PEAK methodology — this command is short-lived and the harness's 10ms sampler is bimodal on it (catches full process init on slow/loaded machines: 11584 KiB on CI run 36822610879; misses the peak entirely on fast machines: 24-444 KiB locally, 256 KiB on CI run 36816604737). Baseline set to the true peak measured with a 1ms poller over 3 runs, so both sampler modes pass while a genuine regression above the peak +10% still fails. Absolute wall: 100 MiB ceiling in docs/memory/budgets/current.json.
